issues.legal_issue: A statutory conversion of a subtenancy into a direct tenancy does not alter the subtenancy’s existing monthly tenancy period.
material_facts: The subtenant’s tenancy was monthly and ran from the first day to the last day of each calendar month.
After the head tenancy was determined by an ejectment decree made partway through a month, the subtenant became the landlord’s direct tenant.
The landlord’s notice required possession at the end of a calendar month, and the subtenant challenged it on the ground that the new tenancy ran from the date of the ejectment decree.
issues.conclusion: The conversion did not shift the monthly tenancy period to begin on the date the head tenancy was determined. The notice requiring possession at the end of the calendar month was valid.
issues.legal_principle: Section 13(2) of the West Bengal Premises Rent Control (Temporary Provisions) Act, 1950 deems a qualifying sub-lessee to hold directly under the landlord on the terms and conditions on which the sub-lessee would have held under the tenant if that tenancy had not been determined. The provision changes the subtenant’s landlord, but does not alter the existing tenancy period; accordingly, a monthly tenancy running by calendar months remains so after the conversion. No earlier cases are relied on in the judgment.

rule.if: statutory_subtenant_case and head_tenancy_ended_midmonth and subtenancy_ran_by_calendar_months and notice_expired_at_calendar_month_end

predicates.statutory_subtenant_case: The case concerns a subtenant who becomes the landlord’s direct tenant when the head tenancy is determined.
predicates.head_tenancy_ended_midmonth: The head tenancy was determined during a month rather than at the end of that month.
predicates.subtenancy_ran_by_calendar_months: The subtenancy ran in monthly periods beginning on the first day and ending on the last day of each calendar month.
predicates.notice_expired_at_calendar_month_end: The notice required possession at the end of a calendar month.

issues.definition: When a subtenant becomes the direct tenant after the head tenancy ends midmonth, an existing calendar-month tenancy period remains unchanged, so a notice expiring at a calendar month’s end is valid.
